title: ICU Foundation Model: Evaluation and further development of a universal intensive care data prediction model based on routine data from Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin
summary: This study uses existing treatment data from everyday clinical practice to develop and test computer models with artificial intelligence (AI). These models are intended to help detect critical changes in the condition of intensive care patients at an early stage. In the long term, this should make medical care safer and easier to plan without the need for new examinations or procedures.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of adult intensive care patients (≥18 years) who completed their intensive care stay during the study period.
